name: muesli-agent
description: Use when working with local Muesli meetings, notes, dictations, Vidshot captures, audio-file transcription, or raw transcripts through the bundled `muesli-cli` CLI. Prefer this skill when a coding agent needs to transcribe local audio, inspect transcripts or Vidshot captures, summarize meetings with its own model, or write notes back into Muesli without requiring the user's API keys.
